Uses of Package
org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model

  • Packages that use org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model 
    Package Description
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.business
    Computation library EJB and computation exception classes.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.java
    Computations implemented in Java.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.computation.model
    Computation result data classes: each class name is unique to a computation so that automated data collection into ProcedureOutput subclasses can be performed without conflict.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.config.business
    Database updates/queries for constants, global configuration, procedure configuration; configuration data caches; real-time configuration of external interfaces.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model
    Data models and database entities for procedure configuration, global configuration, computation configuration, constants and procedure execution preferences.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.config.ui
    JSF controllers and converters supporting global configuration, sufs zernike orders and missing spots user interfaces.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.business
    CCD Frame file and database reading/writing; Frame simulation; Frame marking utilities.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.instrument.model
    PCS instrument configuration data model and database entities.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.business
    Procedure execution management, procedure execution state, procedure store and retrieval, procedure output store and retrieval.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.executor
    Executors for procedures and subflows implemented as Singleton EJBs.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.model
    Procedure database related entities and the complete procedure output class hierarchy
    org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.ui
    Procedure user interface Controllers managing procedure setup, asynchronous frame display and marking, asynchronous dialog rendering, archived procedure viewing.
    org.tmt.aps.peas.refBeamMap.business
    Database storing and retrieval of centroid maps, reference beam maps and subimage definitions.
